settingsNumbering.numberingDescription: How invoices, cash sales, credit notes, debit notes and quotes are numbered. Cash sales have their own series, separate from tax invoices. Numbers stay in order with no gaps, as the FTA requires.
settingsNumbering.numberingReadOnly: Only an owner or admin can change numbering.
settingsNumbering.numberingLastIssued: Last issued: {last}. The next number can only move forward.
settingsNumbering.numberingBelowIssued: The next number must be above {last}, the last number issued.
settingsNumbering.numberingFtaNote: Changing the prefix or digits only changes how new numbers are written; numbers already issued never change.
settingsNumbering.numberingLoadFailed: Could not load your numbering settings. Check your connection and try again.
settingsNumbering.numberingEmpty: No numbered documents are set up for this company yet.
settingsNumbering.numberingSaveFailed: Could not save numbering. Try again in a moment.
settingsNumbering.numberingRefreshFailed: Could not refresh your numbering settings.
settingsNumbering.numberingSaveWaiting: Waiting for a connection. Keep this page open to save when you reconnect.
